Name: Duffy and Friends Dolls
Author: ICEcavities
Description:
The dolls are part of Disney’s “Duffy and Friends” series, each with a unique character and story that makes them special companions.  I made them into ornaments that I could keep at home or outdoors.

Including
[list]
[*]Duffy
[*]ShellieMay
[*]Gelatoni
[*]StellaLou
[*]CookieAnn
[*]Olu Mel
[*]LinaBell
[/list]
The winter outfits for each of these characters add a seasonal charm, making them perfect for collectors and fans alike. Additional series and outfits for these characters will be uploaded in the future.

Please download the CP mode for version 1.6. After installation,
you can find the dolls in [u]the furniture catalog[/u]. Each is priced at [u]50[/u].
(hope everyone can easily have the warmest Disney partner in the world)

This mod requires [b][url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/b][b]﻿[/b].
